_comment: Canonical curation themes for the shader browser. A shader's manifest "category" field must be one of these ids (case-insensitive); anything absent or unknown is grouped under "uncategorized". displayName / description are for contributor docs and store copy.

categories.description: Warping, kaleidoscopic, feedback-heavy visuals — tunnels, swirls, plasmas and trails that melt and pulse with the music.
Clean geometry and restrained motion — grids, gradients, single shapes and lattices that stay calm and legible.
Vintage screen aesthetics — CRT scanlines, VHS glitch, film burn, synthwave grids and analog TV artifacts.
Organic and atmospheric scenes — auroras, water, smoke, light rays and blooming forms.
Shaders with no curation theme set. Add a "category" field to a shader's manifest entry to file it under a theme.
